explanation: Two heavy bodies (1: m~17.72 and 2: m~17.86) undergo a head-on close passage reaching distance 0.336 at step 26, comparable to softening 0.3, with speeds ~11-12. Per-outer-step motion ~0.3 is comparable to separation/softening scale, and substeps_in_step stays capped at 6 (steps 20,24,25,26 all show 6), so the leapfrog substepping fails to resolve the steep acceleration/turnaround at periapsis, producing a ~150 energy swing in one step (102.45 to -47.35) and violating energy_conserved. Reducing dt alone removes the violation, confirming timestep-resolution cause.
